messages:
rhea: opened PR to expand the model-catalog coverage for the Aegis2 family. Goals: update limits table, add a concise "Migration checklist" for quant variants, include a small bench matrix, and fix a stale link to the old quant guide. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5348
mikhail: nice. Can you include the exact sequence ceiling for aegis2-quant? A customer hit silent KV truncation at 3072 on edge devices. Call that out explicitly.
tara: also add the runtime compatibility matrix row. runtime 3.0 -> partial (no fused-attn for aegis2-quant); runtime 3.2+ -> full. Put a short note linking to runtime release notes.
revan: for the SDK snippet show three flavours: exact pin, family-stable pin, and unpinned. Minimal example: 
```
# exact pin (recommended for reproducible prod)
client.generate(model="aegis2-13b@2026-07-01", prompt="...")
# family pin (allow compatible variants within the family)
client.generate(model="aegis2-13b@stable", prompt="...")
# unpinned (platform may upgrade)
client.generate(model="aegis2-13b", prompt="...")
```
mikhail: bench numbers I ran on p4d (batch=1, seq=512): aegis2-13b fp16 pinned = 840 toks/s; aegis2-13b-quant cold-path = 655 toks/s; quant on runtime 3.2 + kernel-selector = 820 toks/s. I'll attach the raw CSV.
tara: add a short table note: measurements are cold-start numbers unless noted, batch=1, seq=512. That helps reproducibility.
rhea: good. I'll add the table and the CSV. Also replacing old link docs/quant-old-guide.md -> docs/quant/overview.md and will add a redirect.
docs-bot: PR #5348 opened by rhea: docs/model-catalog: aegis2 family - limits, migration checklist, bench matrix (labels: docs, model-catalog)
mikhail: one more: include the audit event name MODEL_PIN_FALLBACK and an example log line so customers can monitor for unexpected fallbacks. Saved a customer from a rollout surprise.
revan: let's also show a tiny fallback-policy JSON customers can paste to prefer low-latency variants (example only). Keeps docs actionable.
tara: wording nit: use active phrasing "the platform will fall back" when describing fallback behavior. Clear and prescriptive.
rhea: will update copy and add follow-ups: mikhail - attach CSV + raw logs; evan - prepare the fallback policy snippet and put it in the Migration section; tara - drop the compatibility one-liner for the matrix. I'll push edits by EOD and request reviews.
mikhail: uploading CSV now.
evan: fallback policy snippet ready, will PR the snippet in 30m.
tara: one-liner compatibility text pushed to the PR.
rhea: thanks all. plan: merge after CI and one approval unless major wording issues. ping me for urgent edits. :thumbsup:
mikhail: LGTM once CSV is attached.
evan: +1
tara: +1
rhea: merging after CI then. thanks everyone! :rocket:
